title: Cardiovascular digital twins using a Windkessel physics informed neural network
task: Estimate personalized cardiovascular parameters and predict blood pressure waveforms using Windkessel physics-informed neural networks

comments: Elegant physics-informed approach enabling interpretable CDTs from minimal bioimpedance data; validation on synthetic and healthy/hypertensive cohorts promising but limited dataset diversity.
